title: Face Descriptors Content Formats V1.5
description: Face descriptor content formats. Uses oneOf with const+description so each value is self-documented.

oneOf.description: An action-unit taxonomy that codes visible facial muscle movements; widely used in research and behavioral annotation.
ISO/IEC 14496 (MPEG-4) Face & Body Animation parameter set (66 low-level + high-level FAPs) controlling standardized facial feature points for animation/visemes.
Apple ARKit's canonical 52 blendshape coefficient set (e.g., jawOpen, mouthSmileLeft) for real-time facial expression tracking and avatar animation.
Google MediaPipe's dense 468 3D facial landmark topology used for real-time face geometry and expression estimation.
The 68-point landmark annotation scheme popularized by the 300-W/i.bug datasets (outer contour, eyes, brows, nose, mouth).
Landmark Point Block defined within ISO/IEC 19794-5 Face Image Data records for biometric face image interchange.
InsightFace ArcFace embedding trained with Additive Angular Margin loss; a 512-dimension L2-normalised descriptor compared by cosine similarity. The glintr100 model is a ResNet-100 ArcFace variant.
Face embedding trained with Large Margin Cosine loss (LMCL); a 512-dimension descriptor compared by cosine similarity.
Face embedding trained with angular softmax (A-Softmax) loss on a hypersphere manifold.
Google FaceNet embedding trained with triplet loss (Schroff et al. 2015); a 128-dimension descriptor compared by Euclidean or cosine distance.
CMU OpenFace 128-dimension embedding, an open FaceNet-style descriptor.
Dlib's ResNet-based 128-dimension face embedding used by the dlib/face_recognition library.
Descriptor from a ResNet-50 trained on the VGGFace2 dataset; a high-dimension embedding compared by cosine similarity.
ArcFace variant whose embedding magnitude encodes face quality (Meng et al. 2021); a 512-dimension descriptor.
Quality-adaptive margin face embedding (Kim et al. 2022) robust to low-quality images; a 512-dimension descriptor.
